note: Card edits provided by the designers. Types and levels are theirs.

Minor Wording Change.explanation: The words have been changed, but the card does the same.

Errata.explanation: We screwed up. A replacement is being provided asap.

Edge case fix.explanation: There are situations in which case this card can be broken, so a new version was devised. If you have the old version, you are perfectly fine, unless you're literally trying to provoke the situation we are addressing.

Typo.explanation: Typo, usually in the card's name. Nothing gameplay relevant.

Minor Effect Change.explanation: The words have been changed, and it now technically does something different in a small way. If you have the old card and don't have any weird questions, then there is nothing to worry about. If you have weird questions, the new wording should be unambiguous.

Cross-set update.explanation: The old version was perfectly fine at the time, but demands of newer boxes required the change. If you're using only the older box, you're fine having the older copy.

Trait fix.explanation: We realized a trait was missing/wrong trait was added to a card. If you can mark it on your card until a replacement can be provided it would be great, but it won't ruin your game if you don't.

Minor Errata.explanation: We screwed up, but it won't really affect you.

Balance Fix.explanation: We realized there is something wrong with the card's balance, and can cause some reproducible issues in its current context. If you can mark it on your card until a replacement can be provided it would be great, but if you don't, it will still be playable, just the card will be noticeably too weak/too strong.
